def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    fraction = remaining / bins
    scores = 1 / (1 + np.abs(fraction - np.round(1 / fraction) * fraction + 1e-6))
    return scores
genes.thought: New algorithm: Use a harmonic-based score function that assigns higher preference to bins whose remaining capacity after placing the item corresponds to a rational fraction of the bin size, thus encouraging placements that divide the bin capacity into simpler, more manageable proportions.
